zh: 请填好这张表，然后交到前台。
en: Please {fill in|fill out|complete} this form and take it to reception.

zh: 她花了一整晚仔细研读合同。
en: She spent all night {poring over|going through|studying|reading through} the contract.

zh: 这条规定没办法绕过去。
en: There's no way to {get round|get around|avoid|bypass} the rule.

zh: 有人把我的钱包交到了警察局。
en: Someone {handed in|turned in} my wallet at the police station.

zh: 所有访客都要在前台签到。
en: All visitors need to {sign in} at reception.

zh: 保险公司赔了我们三千块。
en: The insurance company {paid out|paid} three thousand dollars.

zh: 银行已经取消了纸质对账单。
en: The bank has {done away with|got rid of|scrapped|abolished|dropped|ditched} paper statements.

zh: 在电话里等了一个小时，我终于打通了税务局。
en: After an hour on hold, I finally {got through} to IRD.
You've {left out|missed|forgotten|skipped} your date of birth.

zh: 我把旧的银行对账单撕碎了。
en: I {tore up|ripped up|shredded} the old bank statements.

zh: 今天早上我把护照申请寄出去了。
en: I {sent off|posted|mailed|sent} my passport application this morning.

zh: 我该怎么着手申请签证？
en: How do I {go about} applying for a visa?

zh: 把表格底下那一联撕下来自己留着。
en: {Tear off|Rip off|Detach} the bottom of the form and keep it.

zh: 我的签证终于批下来了。
我出去一下，去邮局寄个包裹。
en: I'm just {popping out|nipping out|ducking out|running out} to the post shop to send a parcel.
